components.role: Serves as an uncertainty-aware surrogate model or epistemic component to capture residuals, model infinite-dimensional spaces, or provide probabilistic predictions.
Drives sequential decision-making or outer-loop optimization procedures by evaluating acquisition functions over surrogate models or operator networks.
Learns mappings between infinite-dimensional function spaces or provides operator network backbones (such as DeepONets) for predicting system responses or partial differential equations.

target_task.text: Composite Bayesian optimization and sequential decision-making for systems defined by operators or functions in infinite-dimensional spaces.

limitation.text: Standard Bayesian optimization and deep ensembles in operator learning can incur substantial computational costs and lack efficient epistemic uncertainty quantification.

combination.text: Gaussian process methods and uncertainty-aware operator network architectures are integrated into Bayesian optimization frameworks to enable data-efficient sequential decision-making and composite optimization in function spaces.

summary.text: Gaussian process methods and uncertainty-aware operator network architectures are integrated into Bayesian optimization frameworks to enable data-efficient sequential decision-making and composite optimization in function spaces. Standard Bayesian optimization and deep ensembles in operator learning can incur substantial computational costs and lack efficient epistemic uncertainty quantification.

target_user.text: Company assignees patenting optimization tools, process parameters, and multi-tenant cloud configurations.

jtbd.text: Optimizing industrial process flowsheets and solving composite Bayesian optimization problems where inputs or outputs are functions defined in infinite-dimensional spaces.

value_prop.text: Achieving state-of-the-art performance while requiring orders of magnitude less trainable parameters than deep ensembles of comparable performance.

riskiest_assumption.text: The feasibility score is lowest (dvf:13) because integrating Gaussian processes with operator learning models inside a Bayesian optimization loop may fail to maintain calibration and computational tractability under high-dimensional function spaces.

mvp.text: Build a technical proof of concept script combining an open-source operator network package with Gaussian process and Bayesian optimization packages to solve a low-dimensional function-space optimization task, measuring whether end-to-end execution completes below a proposed threshold of 60 seconds per iteration (dvf:13).
mvp.type: technical proof of concept from existing packages

success_metric.text: Achieve an optimization regret reduction of a proposed threshold of 20 percent compared to baseline single-fidelity optimization while keeping inference time below a proposed threshold of 5 seconds per function evaluation (dvf:13, paper:2404.03099).

kill_criteria.text: The integration fails to converge on standard function-space benchmark tasks within a proposed threshold of 500 optimization steps (dvf:13, paper:2404.03099).
Computational overhead of the combined surrogate model exceeds a proposed threshold of 300 percent relative to standard Gaussian process regression (dvf:13, paper:2503.03178).

open_source.use: Provides the blackbox and hyperparameter optimization backend for sequential decision-making.
Serves as a Bayesian optimization toolbox built on Gaussian processes.
Provides prior-data fitted networks for rapid probabilistic modeling.
Supplies surrogate modeling tools for engineering design optimization.

to_build.text: An adapter layer that translates infinite-dimensional function space outputs from operator networks into finite-dimensional vector representations compatible with standard Gaussian process acquisition functions (dvf:13, paper:2404.03099).
